PART I
Item 1.    Business
Company Background
The Company designs, manufactures and markets widgets and related services. The Company’s fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September. The Company is a California corporation established in 1977 and sells its products worldwide through its retail and online stores, its direct sales force, and third-party cellular network carriers, wholesalers, retailers and resellers.
Products
Widget is the Company’s line of connected devices based on its proprietary operating system. Services include advertising, cloud storage, digital content and payment services. The Company also offers extended warranty coverage under the AcmeCare brand across all of its hardware lines in most of the countries where it operates.
Competition
The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition and resulting downward pressure on gross margins. Competitors include Globex Corporation and Initech, Inc. For more detail on competitive risks see Item 1A. Risk Factors below and the discussion of pricing pressure in Item 7 of this report.
Item 1A.    Risk Factors
The Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including those described below. When any one or more of these risks materialize from time to time, the Company’s business can be affected in a materially adverse way.
Risks Related to the Company’s Supply Chain
The Company depends on a single supplier, Foundry Co., Ltd., for substantially all of its advanced components. Substantially all of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in Asia, including Assembly Partners Inc. A significant disruption at any of these partners could materially adversely affect the Company’s results.
Item 1B.    Unresolved Staff Comments
None.
Item 2.    Properties
The Company’s headquarters are located in Cupertino-on-Thames. As of September 27, 2025, the Company owned or leased facilities and land for corporate functions, R&D, data centers, retail and other purposes at locations throughout the U.S. and in various places outside the U.S. The Company believes its existing facilities and equipment are in good operating condition.
PART II
Item 7.    Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K. Total net sales increased 7% or $25.3 billion during 2025 compared to 2024 due primarily to higher net sales of Services and Widgets. The weakness in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar had an unfavorable impact on net sales during 2025.

Widgets net sales decreased 2% during 2025 compared to 2024 due to lower net sales of entry-level models, partially offset by higher net sales of premium models. Services net sales increased 13% during 2025 compared to 2024 due primarily to higher net sales from advertising, cloud services and the AcmeCare program.
Item 7A.    Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
The Company is exposed to economic risk from interest rates and foreign exchange rates. The Company uses interest rate swap sensitivity analysis to assess the effect of a hypothetical 100 basis point increase in rates on the fair value of its investment portfolio. The Company’s exposure to foreign exchange rate risk relates primarily to net sales and operating expenses denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar. The Company may enter into foreign currency forward and option contracts to offset some of this exposure, and a hypothetical 10% adverse movement in exchange rates would have reduced the fair value of those contracts by approximately $1.1 billion as of September 27, 2025. The Company does not hedge for speculative purposes.
